headline: TI and Cadence authors report an EEnet analog test-bus verification method
fact: A Texas Instruments and Cadence DAC 2025 presentation reports an EEnet-based analog test-bus method for checking voltage, current, loading, and coupling behavior. The authors describe using the real-number abstraction to reduce reliance on AMS simulation for the presented verification tasks. This is a reported customer/vendor method, not a claim that EEnet replaces circuit-level verification.

sources.title: Revolutionising SOC Verification through System Verilog EEnet-Enhanced Behavioural Model for Precision in Analog IP Characterisation
sources.summary: The official DAC 2025 record identifies TI and Cadence authors and describes EEnet-based voltage, current, loading, and coupling checks with reduced AMS-simulation dependence for the presented tasks.
